preboarding.label: Preboarding
preboarding.description: The task lists a preboarding starts with. Preboarding is for somebody who has not signed in yet, and happens on one page behind a link.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.description: The task lists an onboarding starts with. Onboarding happens inside the app, once the new person has signed in.

offboarding.label: Offboarding
offboarding.description: The task lists an offboarding starts with, counted from the last working day — handing over work, returning equipment, the exit interview.

listPage.title: Automations
listPage.description: Rules that do something on their own when something happens to a person — an email before the first day, a task for the manager, the holiday calendar of their office. Assigning by a filter in the assignment window makes a rule here too.

hint.PERSON_HIRED: Counts from the hire date, as soon as there is one.
hint.DATE_OFFSET: Some days before, on or after a date on the profile — once, or every year.
hint.JOINS_SEGMENT: The day somebody first matches the conditions below.
hint.FIELD_CHANGED: Every time the field changes, optionally from one value to another.
hint.TERMINATION_SCHEDULED: The day a termination is recorded.
hint.LAST_WORKING_DAY_ARRIVES: Counts from the person's last working day.
hint.EVENT: Time off requested or decided, a process completed, a review submitted or shared.
hint.SCHEDULE: Every day, week, month or quarter, for everybody who matches.

label.REVIEW_SHARED: A review is shared with the person

onTimeout.STOP_AND_TELL: Stop the rest and tell me

trigger.fieldChanged: When {field} changes{hasFrom, select, yes { from {from}} other {}}{hasTo, select, yes { to {to}} other {}}{recorded, select, yes {, when it is recorded} other {}}
trigger.eventOn: When {what}, on {anchor, select, LEAVE_START {the first day of the leave} other {the last day of the leave}}
trigger.eventOffset: When {what}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} {direction, select, AFTER {after} other {before}} {anchor, select, LEAVE_START {the first day of the leave} other {the last day of the leave}}

schedule.monthlyLast: On the last day of every month
schedule.quarterlyLast: On the last day of every quarter's first month

dateOffset.offset: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} {direction, select, AFTER {after} other {before}} the {field}

offset.days: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} {direction, select, after {after} other {before}}

action.waitTaskDone: Wait until task {step} is done, at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
action.waitFieldFilled: Wait until a field is filled, at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
action.waitOther: Wait until something, at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
action.approval: Ask {who} to approve{hasTitle, select, yes {: {title}} other {}}

reason.FORWARD_ONLY: Not run: the rule was enabled for people from then on, and this moment had passed
reason.MOMENT_PASSED: Not run: the moment had already passed
reason.NO_LONGER_MATCHES: Skipped: no longer matches the conditions
reason.ANCHOR_CLEARED: Cancelled: the date it counted from was cleared
reason.NO_RECIPIENT: Skipped: nobody to send it to
reason.NOT_ASSIGNED: Skipped: nothing of this rule's to take back
reason.HAND_OVERRIDE: Skipped: set by hand to something else
reason.OUTRANKED: Skipped: a more specific place gives this person their holiday calendar
reason.MISSING_PLACEHOLDER: Failed: a placeholder has no value
reason.STRUCTURAL: Failed: something the rule uses is gone
reason.CONDITION_NOT_MET: Skipped: its "only if" did not hold
reason.OBJECT_CLOSED: Cancelled: the leave it counted from was cancelled or rejected
reason.MISSED: Missed: the engine did not run on that day
reason.TIMED_OUT: Waited as long as it may

definition.skippedIfPast: skipped if the date is already past

activation.disabled: Disabled. {cancelled, plural, one {# scheduled run was cancelled} other {# scheduled runs were cancelled}}; {completed, plural, one {# finished run stays as it is} other {# finished runs stay as they are}}.
activation.enabled: Enabled. {planned, plural, one {# run is} other {# runs are}} planned.
activation.resumed: Resumed. {planned, plural, one {# run is} other {# runs are}} planned.

gate.noName: Give the automation a name to publish it.
gate.noActions: Add at least one action to publish.
gate.problems: Fix what the preview lists to publish.

rule.systemOwned: This automation is the Holiday Calendar of {source}. Change it there.

authorGone.left: Its owner{hasName, select, yes {, {name},} other {}} has left or cannot sign in, so it no longer runs.
authorGone.lacksRight: Its owner may no longer do everything it does, so it is paused.
authorGone.hint: Take it over to run it in your name.

paused.title: This automation is paused
paused.fixHint: Fix what it points at, publish, and resume it from the menu.

archive.title: Archive automation
archive.description: It stops running and leaves the list; scheduled runs are cancelled. What already ran stays as it is. You can unarchive it later.

delete.title: Delete automation
delete.description: It has never run for anybody, so it is removed with all its versions.

leave.title: Leave without publishing?
leave.description: The changes to this automation are only in this page. Leaving now discards them.

when.fireEffective: On the day it takes effect
when.fireRecorded: On the day it is recorded
when.changeHint: Once, when the change happens. To give or keep something while a person is in a department or an office, use "Someone starts matching" instead — it also takes it back when they leave.

anchor.LEAVE_START: The first day of the leave
anchor.LEAVE_END: The last day of the leave

when.leaveMoves: A leave moved later moves these steps with it; a leave cancelled or rejected cancels them.
when.scheduleHint: In the company's time zone, for every person who matches on that day. A day the engine missed is caught up once, late.
when.latePast: If the date is already past
when.runLateHint: Do it today, and say in the run log that it ran late.
when.skipHint: Leave it out — a dated email sent days late can be worse than none.
when.lateWindowHint: Older than this is skipped either way, so an import does not send a welcome to everyone. Default {days}.

forWhom.matching: {count, plural, one {# person matches} other {# people match}} now
forWhom.hint: With no conditions the rule is for everyone. The conditions are checked when a run is planned and again just before each step.

do.summary: {count, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}}, in this order
do.empty: Add what should happen — an email, a task, an assignment.
do.removeDescription: This action is taken out of the draft. Nothing changes until you publish.

actionEditor.onlyIfHint: Checked on the day this step runs. When it does not hold, this step is skipped and the rest goes on.
actionEditor.subject: Subject
actionEditor.title: Title
actionEditor.untilTask: A task of this rule is done
actionEditor.addTaskFirst: Add a task before this wait
actionEditor.approvalHint: The approver gets a task with Approve and Decline. The steps after this one wait for the answer; a decline stops them.

eventCondition.empty: Every such event, whatever its details.

owner.changeDescription: The automation runs in the new owner's name from now on, and they are told when it fails or pauses.
owner.alsoDescription: When a run fails, a wait times out or the automation pauses, these people are told too.

placeholderField.hint: Type @ to insert a field — the first name, a date, the leave.

preview.title: Preview
preview.noTrigger: The preview appears as soon as the rule has a trigger.
preview.volume: One firing sends about {count} notifications and emails.
preview.pastMoment: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} already past the moment — they are left out unless you choose otherwise when enabling.
preview.eventDriven: This trigger waits for something to happen, so nothing can be dated ahead.
preview.nothingDue: Nothing is due in the next 30 days.
preview.noValue: No value for {tokens} — this step would fail for {name}.
preview.conflictLine: {person}: {rule} already sets the {kind} — the later rule does not overwrite it.

none.title: Only people from now on
none.detail: Whoever reaches the moment from today. Anybody already past it is left as they are.

all.title: Also people who already match
all.detail: Also everybody whose moment has already passed — their steps run today.
all.detailCount: Also {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} whose moment has already passed — their steps run today.

publish.volumeConfirm: One firing sends about {count} notifications and emails at once. I mean it.
publish.descNew: The rule is saved as version 1.
publish.descNewMatching: The rule is saved as version 1. {count, plural, one {# person matches} other {# people match}} it now.
publish.descExisting: A published version is never edited — this becomes the version every new run follows.
publish.underWay: {count, plural, one {# run is} other {# runs are}} under way
publish.keepTitle: Keep in-flight on the current version
publish.keepDetail: {count, plural, one {# scheduled run finishes} other {# scheduled runs finish}} as version {version} said. Only new firings use the new version.
publish.moveTitle: Move everyone to the new version
publish.moveDetail: Runs not started yet are planned again: {cancelled} cancelled, {added} added. {partDone, plural, one {# run already part-done stays} other {# runs already part-done stay}} on version {version}.
publish.completed: {count, plural, one {# completed run is} other {# completed runs are}} unaffected either way — what was sent or assigned is never rewritten.
publish.staysDisabled: It stays disabled; enable it from the menu when you are ready.
publish.waiting: {count, plural, one {# run is} other {# runs are}} waiting for a task, a field or an approval — they stay on version {version} either way.
publish.enableDescription: From now on the rule runs on its own. Who should it cover?

startReview.noTemplates: No review templates yet. Save a cycle as a template in <link>Reviews</link> first.
startReview.hint: Days count from the moment the rule fires, like a task's due date. The review is started and launched for the person on the step's day; if the cycle cannot launch, the run log says why.

problem.dueBeforeOpens: The {kind} is due before it opens.
problem.peersOrder: Peers are approved before they are nominated.
problem.peerDates: Say when peers are nominated and approved.
problem.releaseDate: The template releases its results on a date: say when.

outcome.NOT_CREATED: A task — not created in a test
outcome.NOT_SENT: Changes data — not done in a test
outcome.NO_EMAIL: Not emailed: you have no address

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.forPerson: For {name}. Nothing runs, nobody else is told.
tryIt.choose: Choose a sample person in the preview.

note.doesNotMatch: This person does not match the rule's conditions today, so it would not run for them.
note.noAnchorDate: This person has no date for the rule to count from.
note.momentPassed: The moment has passed: the late policy decides what runs.
note.scheduleIncomplete: The schedule is incomplete and never fires.
note.eventCountedToday: Counted as if the event happened today.
note.eventCountedTodayLeaveDates: Counted as if the event happened today; a leave's own dates move these days.
note.stepSkipped: Skipped: its "only if" does not hold for this person today
note.stepAfterWait: Runs once the wait before it lets the run go on
note.stepWaitsForApproval: Waits for the approval, at most {maxDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}; a refusal stops the rest
note.stepWaits: Waits, at most {maxDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then {onTimeout, select, CONTINUE {goes on with the rest} STOP {stops the rest} STOP_AND_TELL {stops the rest and tells you} other {goes on with the rest}}

welcomeEmail.name: Welcome email
welcomeEmail.subject: Welcome to {companyName}, {firstName}

managerDayOne.name: First day with the manager
managerDayOne.taskDescription: Show {firstName} around and introduce them to the team.

terminationHr.name: Termination recorded
terminationHr.text: {fullName}'s termination was recorded. Their last working day is {lastWorkingDay}.

welcomeEmail.name: Welcome email before the first day
welcomeEmail.description: Three days before the start date, an email to the new person. Skipped for somebody whose start has passed.

managerFirstDay.name: A task for the manager on the first day
managerFirstDay.description: On the start date, the manager gets a task to welcome the new person.

probationReview.name: Confirm the end of probation
probationReview.description: Two weeks before probation ends, the manager is asked to approve it; HR is told when they do.

workAnniversary.name: Work anniversary
workAnniversary.description: Every year on the start date, the manager is reminded.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.description: Every year on the birthday, the manager is reminded.

documentExpiry.name: A document about to expire
documentExpiry.description: Thirty days before a date field — a visa, a certificate — the person and their manager are told. Choose the date field.

longLeave.name: A long leave approved
longLeave.description: When ten days or more of leave are approved, the manager's manager is told.

onboardingDone.name: Onboarding completed
onboardingDone.description: When an onboarding completes, the manager is told.

terminationHr.name: Tell HR about a termination
terminationHr.description: When a termination is recorded, everybody of a role is told. Choose the role.

lastDayEquipment.name: Collect equipment on the last day
lastDayEquipment.description: On the last working day, the manager gets a task to collect the equipment.

departmentMove.name: Moved to another department
departmentMove.description: When somebody's department changes, their manager and the department's head are told.

monthlyDetails.name: A monthly reminder to check one's details
monthlyDetails.description: On the first day of each month, everybody is reminded to check their personal details.

calendarByOffice.name: Holiday calendar by office
calendarByOffice.description: Everybody of an office gets its holiday calendar, and keeps following it. Choose the office and the calendar.

list.emptyDescription: An automation does something on its own when something happens to a person.
list.noResultsHint: Try a different name, trigger or action.
list.galleryDescription: It opens filled in; nothing is saved until you publish.
list.firstDescription: An automation does something on its own when something happens to a person — a welcome email before their first day, a task for their manager, the right holiday calendar for their office.

versions.emptyDescription: Each publish adds a version here.

runs.backfill: Added when the rule was enabled
runs.retried: The failed steps were planned again for today.
runs.outsideScope: , and {count} about people outside your access
runs.emptyDescription: Every time the rule fires for somebody, the run is listed here with what each step did.
runs.personEmptyDescription: When an automation does something for this person, it is listed here with what each step did.
